label.zh: 结局：冰川期终结，变为海洋星球
label.en: Ending: the ice age ends; an ocean world

note.zh: 星球类型变为海洋，获得海床矿藏；水生主要物种另得凝聚力。
note.en: The planet becomes an ocean world with a mineral seabed deposit; aquatic main species also gain unity.

note.zh: 仅环保主义公民性可走的紧急状态路线，项目完成后移除融化与紧急修正。
note.en: The Environmentalist-only emergency route; the project removes the melting and emergency modifiers.

note.zh: 钻探后的60%结果（仅非机械帝国）：消毒（一人死亡）或隔离（720天远古瘟疫修正）。
note.en: The 60% drilling result (non-machine empires only): sanitize (one pop dies) or quarantine (ancient plague for 720 days).

note.zh: 钻探后的40%结果：获得晶体冰川矿藏。
note.en: The 40% drilling result: a crystalline glacier deposit.

notes.zh: 审阅注：隐藏事件 colony.7229 在殖民地满两年时被抽中（权重8）后，固定在3600天（约十年）后才弹出本事件。研究项目有720天期限，超时失败同样会导致“巨大的洪泛区”。
notes.en: Review note: the hidden colony.7229 is picked at the second anniversary (weight 8) and fires this event exactly 3600 days (about ten years) later. The research project has a 720-day limit; failing it also leads to Vast Floodplains.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择“永霜冻土已经遭受了太多的痛苦”只获得凝聚力，故事在此结束。
notes.en: Review note: "The permafrost has suffered enough" only grants unity and ends the story.

scope.zh: 冰川危机全部10个事件（含隐藏入口7229）与两个研究项目。
scope.en: All 10 Glacial Crisis events (incl. hidden entry 7229) and both research projects.
